answer: Pin each identity to a distinct point in the network: at epoch start, several landmarks measure round-trip latency to the agent, triangulating a rough location that a lone honest operator passes once. A farm spinning up thousands of containers in one datacenter lands in the same nebula of addresses and latencies, so the network pays that whole cluster as one participant. Every extra fake costs rent but adds no reward, and the ripple of a new cluster appearing overnight is easy to spot: at its nadir, a farm's profit collapses to a single share.
